CVE-2026-102359.title: Kroki: TikZ Secure Mode Local File Read via LaTeX File I/O Primitives
CVE-2026-102359.description: Kroki creates diagrams from textual descriptions. Prior to 0.31.2, the TikZ backend's tikz/tikz2svg guard used when KROKI_SAFE_MODE is enabled blocks only \verbatiminput while allowing native TeX file-read primitives including \openin, \read, \input, and \include. The file contents are rendered into the returned SVG, which may disclose mounted secrets, configuration data, credentials, private keys, or process environment data. CVE-2026-115791.title: Prevent shadowing stdlib in gzip/tarfile/zipfile CLI during extraction
CVE-2026-115791.description:
When tarfile or zipfile command line interface (CLI) is used to

decompress an archive, a Python script shadowing the stdlib can be

created. Then if an error occurs during decompressing the next file,

the newly created Python script is executed. This is especially true

if the created Python is called traceback.py. The problem is that

Python adds the current directory to sys.path when python -m MODULE is

run, and the archive is also decompressed in the current directory.

The fix removes sys.path[0] in gzip, tarfile and zipfile command line

interface to prevent shadowing standard library modules from extracted

files.

CVE-2026-131810.description:
United Chargers Grizzl-E Smart 40A Download of Code Without Integrity Check Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of United Chargers Grizzl-E Smart 40A EV chargers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

CVE-2026-99729.title: mm/rmap: handle device-exclusive entries in folio_referenced_one()
CVE-2026-99729.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

mm/rmap: handle device-exclusive entries in folio_referenced_one()

page_vma_mapped_walk() can return non-present device-exclusive entries,
but folio_referenced_one() passes them to PTE young-bit accessors that
require present PTEs.

We must neither call clear_flush_young_ptes_notify() nor
folio_pte_batch() with non-present entries. For example, clearing the
young bit on non-present PTEs can corrupt the entry: on arm64
PTE_AF overlaps the swap type, so clearing it turns a device-exclusive
entry into an ordinary swap entry.

folio_pte_batch() will VM_WARN_ON_FOLIO.

Apply the same approach as the previous fixes to e.g., damon_ptep_mkold():
treat these entries as old from the CPU's perspective and obtain their
young state through the MMU notifier.

Skip PTE batching and MGLRU look-around for non-present entries, and
don't modify non-present PTEs.
